scope: Current Wiki prepare API and Python async/sync SDK/legacy HTTP compatibility; no execution jobs implemented

changes.behavior: Legacy find/search keyword arguments are passed through SDK checked options, preserving context_type enum serialization and telemetry=False defaults. Sync bridge delegates the same contract. Explicit options remain intact; duplicate and unknown option fields are rejected.

BuildRequest and IngestionRequest advertise and enforce idempotency_key ASCII catalog identifiers of length 1 through 128, matching existing planner/catalog constraints instead of advertising 256. Existing prepared HTTP 200 semantics and required keys are retained.
Document current immutable prepare behavior and key bounds; type update_policy as Literal[fail, replace] in both client modes. Server remains validation authority.

Replace stale expectation that configured gateway credentials are inherited when an explicit URL names a different server. Existing SDK URL binding and challenge-only credential forwarding are retained without product changes.

security_contract_evidence.new_coverage: Actual MockTransport requests verify same-URL challenge forwarding, different-URL refusal, and caller-provided gateway headers on either URL.
